content.what_it_is: Official NTHMP laboratory benchmark 4 (BP4, 'Solitary Wave on a Canonical Beach', measured data) MATLAB comparison function -- companion to analyBM_01_SW.m but against Synolakis lab data. Header (L1-159): authors D. Nicolsky, C. Synolakis, S. Grilli, J. Horrillo, NTHMP/NOAA 2010; references Synolakis 1986/1987; lab data files SW_01_00185.mat (H=0.0185, snapshots t=30..70 by 10) and SW_01_03.mat (H=0.30, t=15..30 by 5); model file specs: filename1 441x6 (x, Amp at t=30/40/50/60/70; spec L79-105) and filename2 601x5 (x in [-10,20], Amp at t=15/20/25/30; spec L107-131); usage examples L149-158. Input handling (L161-196): NaN placeholders (441x6 / 601x5), load + eval by filename stem, model-name prefixes str3/str4. Loads lab .mat files (L198, L200). Setup (L202-212): case labels, marker color cc=[1 0 0], beach X=[-10:1:20], slp=1/19.85, Y=-slp*X. Figure 1 (fig2, L217-226): five stacked panels for H=0.0185 at t=30/40/50/60/70 (subplot(5,1,k)); per panel when model present: Norm=max-min of lab data, lab x clipped to [-10,20], model interpolated to lab x (interp1, e.g. a_30n L233), NaN filled from beach line, NRMSD err=sqrt(sum((model-lab)^2)/N)/Norm*100 with N=length(ina)+length(ina1) (L245), max-amplitude error err1 (L247), echo [t max_lab max_model]; plotting: slope, model dashed, lab dots, panel axes ([-2 20] windows with growing ymax 0.04/0.04/0.08/0.10, t=70 [-0.04 0.06]), NRMSD/ERR annotations. Figure 2 (fig1) for H=0.30 (from L476 area): four panels t=15/20/25/30 (subplot(4,1,k)), same per-panel machinery on a2 columns 2-5 against a1_15/a1_20/a1_25/a1_30 lab arrays with axes [-10 20 -0.10 0.50]; t=30 block retains commented SELFE-specific alternative err1 lines; ends with 'return' as last executable line (L692 area).
entities: function labBM_04_SW(filename1,filename2) @L1 (single-function file; header/help L2-159; help call @L161)

variables: str3 @L162, str4 @L163, err @L164, err1 @L165, a1 @L167/L173/L179, a2 @L168/L185/L191, len/len3/len4 @L177/L181/L189/L193, str @L202, str1 @L204, str2 @L205, cc @L207, X @L210, slp @L211, Y @L212, fig2 @L217, per-panel Norm/x_30n../a_30n../ina/ina1/N/ax1, fig1 (H=0.30 figure), lab arrays x_30..x_70, a_30..a_70, x1_15..x1_30, a1_15..a1_30 from the .mat files

equations.ref: model onto lab x, t=30 (analogues per panel)

calls: help @L161; ones/nan placeholders @L167-168, @L173, @L185; load @L176, @L188, @L198, @L200; strfind/eval filename materialization @L177-181, @L189-193; figure/set/annotation @L217-226 and H=0.30 figure; find/isnan, interp1, sqrt/sum/max/min/abs/length per panel; subplot(5,1,1..5) and subplot(4,1,1..4); plot/hold/text/legend/axis/grid/xlabel/ylabel/num2str throughout; return (final executable statement)

verbatim_spans.text: %               AUTHOR(S)     : D. Nicolsky, C. Synolakis, S Grilli
str='Solitary Wave on a Simple Beach';

unresolved: The t=60 echo row is labeled [30 ...] instead of [60 ...] (first line of the t=60 echo block, chunk boundary L401) -- copy-paste slip in the reported time index.

NRMSD denominator N=length(ina)+length(ina1) counts beach-filled NaN points as data (L244-245), unlike analyBM_01_SW.m which uses N=length(xn) -- small definitional difference between the two official scripts.
load()+eval by filename stem (L179, L191) has the same fragility as the analytical script (variable name must match file stem).
The final 'return' (L692) is redundant at function end; commented '%SELFE' alternatives (L662, L664) show model-specific tweaks left in the official script.
Panel axis windows [-2 20] for H=0.0185 vs the clip window [-10,20] used in the error computation (x_30n L232) -- errors include points outside the displayed axis.
